itemtype:cyberware.text: Read the Essence cost twice. The doc only reads it once.

itemtype:weapon.text: Buy the gun you can afford to throw in the river.
And buy two. The river's hungry.

itemtype:armor.text: Armor jacket. Boring. Alive. Pick one.
Pick alive. Boring gets you to the next run.
Boring with a lining. I know a tailor.

itemtype:vehicle.text: Your ride is your getaway, your office and occasionally your coffin. Spend accordingly.
...and occasionally your coffin. Buy the one with the armour.

itemtype:program.text: A deck's only as good as the code on it. And the decker's only as good as their nerve.
And the decker's only as good as their exit plan.
